color.description:
The color of the selection indicator for items.
For nodes, this is the color of a halo which is added around the node.
For links, this is the color of a selection marker which is added to the middle of the link.

highlightNeighborsOnSelect.description:
Configuration to control if 1st degree neighbors of a node or an edge should be highlighted
when they are selected.

labelColor.description: The font color of any labels on the selected item.

multiSelectionBehavior.description:
Options to control how node multi-selection affects 1st degree neighbor highlighting. Only takes effect if
{@link highlightNeighborsOnSelect} is set to true.

title: The configuration to control the appearance and behavior of selected items.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationSelectionConfig
